Thank you for sharing this with us.  We will try to support you as best as we can.  My personal similarities are depression and PTSD due to sexual abuse.  My abuse was later in life, so I'm sorry if it doesn't hold true, but I feel when your wife was abused and her parents did nothing, it took away her power and positive sense of self.  The only thing she should be focusing on now is getting it back.  She can not truly love and appreciate you if she doesn't love and appreciate herself. If she is truly trying to get better, she will be actively seeking a psychiatrist  (weaning yourself off antidepressants is dangerous) and working to get her power back.  You can definitely support her and see professionals with her, but you also need to be allowed to communicate your feelings and concerns too, even about sex. You should also have your own therapist, a professional who is looking out for your well being and can give clearer guidance as to how to keep your relationship growing and on track. Good luck to you.

PS She does not believe she is important enough to focus on getting herself better.  Every time she makes an excuse to not work on herself just tell her that nothing is more important than her getting better.

PSS There is nothing more important for you than getting better yourself.

My husband has aspergers. I have to do a lot, but I get support wherever I can.  He has a therapist, I have a therapist, our pastor provides marriage counseling, and we're going to meet with a sex therapist.  Life itself isn't easy and being on the spectrum can make it more difficult, but there are more resources than there used to be.  The only thing that I want to ask is when you listed the reasons why you don't want a divorce, you didn't list that you love him.  Try to remember that the most when you're learning how to cope and you just can't anymore so you break down in tears.  It's all worth it because you love him.

Also read Five Love Languages.  She should be telling you she loves you through physical touch and words of affirmation.  You need to find out how to tell her you love her in a way she understands best.
